Type: Disposable Device

Boasting an impressive 10k puff capacity, this device features an 18ml e-liquid tank and 5% salt nicotine, delivering rich flavors and smooth hits in every puff.

Available in irresistible flavors, including Watermelon Ice, Blueberry Lime, and Double Apple, the Yuoto vape Thanos-2 caters to every preference. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned vaper, this device is perfect for enjoying extended vaping without the hassle of refilling or frequent recharges.

  • Puff Capacity: +10,000 puffs
  • Battery: 500mAh rechargeable
  • E-liquid Volume: 18ml
  • Nicotine Content: 5% salt nicotine
  • Charging Time: 2 hours
